description: Initialise an renv project-local library for the project using renv::init(). Creates renv/ and renv.lock, and updates .Rprofile.

bare.description: If TRUE, initialise without installing any packages into the new library (default false).

project_path.description: Absolute path to the project root where renv should be initialised.

restart.description: Whether to restart the R session after initialising (default false).

name: renv_init
